verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a structured, tag-organized OpenAPI v2 reference at developers.drata.com/openapi/reference/v2 covering endpoints such as Controls, Policies, Personnel, Devices, Custom Connections and Monitoring Tests. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive (a try-it console) or ships runnable code samples. Probes also found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at common paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/request console, runnable code examples per endpoint, a publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
